title: Price Spikes
prompt:
**Description:** Given n daily prices, count the days that are strict local maxima:
higher than BOTH neighbors (day 1 and day n have only one neighbor).

**Input:** Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 200000). Line 2: n integers (|p[i]| <= 10^9).
**Output:** One integer — the number of strict local maxima.

**Example:** `5` / `1 3 2 3 1` -> `2`.

tests.name: sample
single day
tests.hint: One day with no neighbors — counts.

tests.name: two days
tests.hint: 9 has one neighbor and is higher — counts; 4 does not.

tests.name: plateau
tests.hint: Equal neighbors are not STRICTLY higher.

tests.name: valley endpoints
tests.hint: Both endpoint 5s beat their single neighbor — the middle 1 is the only non-maximum.
